pictures.name: JHO1-Carob
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A rocky, sunlit hillside field in the land of Israel. Honi, a lean, sun-browned man in his fifties with a grey-streaked beard, in a faded russet robe and a cream head cloth, stands leaning on a walking stick, watching a very old man with a long white beard in a brown robe kneel to plant a small carob sapling, patting the earth around it. Warm gold afternoon light, deep blue shadows, olive trees beyond.

pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A shaded hollow among large smooth boulders on the same hillside. Honi, a lean, sun-browned man in his fifties with a grey-streaked beard, in a faded russet robe and a cream head cloth, lies peacefully asleep on his cloak, a half-eaten piece of bread beside him, the rocks curving around to hide him. pictures.name: JHO3-Grandson
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The same hillside, now with a huge, spreading carob tree heavy with dark pods. A cheerful middle-aged man in an ochre tunic picks carob pods into a basket. Before him stands Honi, the same lean man with a now snow-white beard grown long, in the same faded russet robe and cream head cloth, bewildered, looking up at the great tree. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows.
